channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Tartan-Hopkins boys basketball game, suspended because of fight, will resume Tuesday
item.description: A fight Saturday in the stands caused the game to be suspended at Hopkins High. Fan attendance at the restarted game will be limited.

item.title: Hunting and cooking squirrels is in Yia Vang’s blood
item.description: The chef and Outdoor Channel host has hunted Burmese python in the Everglades and fished for alligator gar in Texas. It all started with squirrels.

item.title: Emmer sticks with Trump as president escalates attacks on Somali community
item.description: Before Trump’s comments, Emmer spent years making inroads in the growing Somali community in his district.

item.title: What we learned about the Twins roster during the Major League Baseball winter meetings
item.description: Luke Keaschall might play in the outfield after a strong, but short, rookie season in which he was stationed at second base.

item.title: Another 160-plus restaurants opened in the Twin Cities in 2025. Yes, really.
item.description: From destination dining to suburban surprises, the year delivered another nonstop run of openings.

item.title: Deer hunter accused of illegally bagging moose in northeastern Minnesota
item.description: With the moose population much smaller than it was two decades ago, Minnesota has not had a moose hunting season since 2012.

item.title: Minneapolis nonprofit to close after audit found ‘high risk’ it misused federal funds
item.description: Move Minneapolis lost funding after the Met Council questioned its finances amid an investigation of Jonathan Weinhagen, the former leader of its parent organization.

item.title: For Vikings QB J.J. McCarthy, now ‘it’s about being consistent’
item.description: The Vikings and McCarthy take their momentum on the road to Dallas to face the Cowboys on Sunday night.

item.title: Nisswa Mayor Jennifer Carnahan facing call to resign amid controversy
item.description: One council member asked for the mayor’s immediate resignation. Carnahan, the former chair of the Minnesota Republican Party, said she refuses.

item.title: In the shadow of ICE, a St. Paul neighborhood store steps in to feed its community
item.description: While federal agents patrol the Twin Cities, a St. Paul Mexican grocer is filling a gap for families too frightened to shop.
